incident.description: An event at BMO Stadium lets out: about 400 extra people per minute join the station walkway from minute 15 to minute 35.

actions: [LA28 Venue Ops] Hold crowd in the bowl: release 800 people/min (normally 2,500)
[LA Metro] Run a train every 2 min (normally every 4)
[LA28 Transport / LADOT] Add shuttle buses: 375 people/min (normally 150)
[Venue stewards / LAPD] Steer 80% of the north plaza to shuttles (normally 40%)
briefing: The forecaster predicts the walkway density will hit 4.51 by minute 17, approaching the 5.0 danger threshold. The most_margin plan holds the crowd at 800/min release, adds 375/min shuttle outflow, and steers 80% of north plaza to shuttles, keeping peak density at 1.82 and clearing the stadium by minute 83. You have until minute 10 to approve.
reason: It provides the largest safety margin (peak density 1.82 vs the 5.0 threshold) while keeping extra transit manageable, and it clears the stadium well within the forecast window.
why: Prevents all 112 dangerous zone-minutes (doing nothing peaks at 6.44 people/m²)
Peak 1.82 people/m² at Expo Park/USC platform: the lowest of the 3 safe options
Held up in 5/5 noise runs; approve by minute 10 (8 min from now)
trade_off: Stadium clears at minute 83 (doing nothing: minute 28)
vs least effort: clears at minute 67, peak 4.89, effort 1.88 (this plan: 3.75)
vs fastest clear: clears at minute 34, peak 4.91, effort 3.04 (this plan: 3.75)
